name: react
context: Tasks requiring interleaved reasoning and external tool or API calls where each action depends on the previous observation.
benefits: Grounds reasoning in fresh observations, reducing hallucination
tradeoffs: More LLM calls than plan-first patterns such as REWOO
Can loop without careful iteration control
anti_patterns: Accumulating all observations in context forever
Trusting tool observations without sanitization (prompt injection vector)
Loading all tools into prompt when >10 tools (retrieval vector scoring preferred)
design_principles: One thought, one action, one observation per step
Document tools for the model, not for humans
Sanitize all tool observations before reasoning
best_practices: Use return-focused tool docstrings (describe output, not just parameters)
Use tool retrieval for >10 tools (vector store selecting top 3-5 relevant per query)
Sanitize all tool observations before reasoning
references: Yao et al., ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models, 2023 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.03629
